newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Annan, Arafat arrive for OAU Zimbabwe summit.
newsitem.headline: Annan, Arafat arrive for OAU Zimbabwe summit.

text.p: United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan arrived in Harare on Sunday to attend this week's Organisation of African Unity (OAU) summit.
Annan, the second African to head the world body after Egypt's Boutros Boutros-Ghali, was received by President Robert Mugabe, the incoming OAU chairman.

Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat also jetted into the Zimbabwean capital for the annual meeting. He is expected to seek African support for the Palestinian stance in peace negotiations with Israel which have foundered recently.

The summit, opening on Monday, is expected to discuss Africa's trouble spots including Liberia, where the U.N. has backed efforts by the Nigerian-led ECOWAS to restore the country to constitutional rule.
Annan, a Ghanaian, will join more than 30 African leaders, a majority of whom backed him for the U.N. job after the United States vetoed Ghali's re-election.
